text.ja: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える この問題の式、参照の条件、計算法、公開済みのコードをたどります。 保存済みの結果図 保存した分岐曲線、λ=2の上下枝、Jacobianの最小特異値、3格子のfold誤差を示す縮小図。擬似弧長stepは物理時間ではありません。 方程式・問題の定義 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。 Bratu非線形境界値問題 −d2udx2=λeu,0<x<1 u(0)=u(1)=0 ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 実行例で使う式 補助実行例実行例の定義・検証式 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える −u′′=λeu,u(0)=u(1)=0 uθ=2log⁡cosh⁡(θ/2)cosh⁡(θ(x−1/2)),λ(θ)=2θ2/cosh⁡2(θ/2) 同じ1次元Bratu境界値問題の下枝から上枝までを追跡し、接線・fold・独立解析族との空間誤差を調べます。 厳密解・参照解 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの67固定判定が合格。離散残差、接線の向き・単位長、fold方程式・null条件・transversality、独立Decimal80解析族、固定3格子の誤差を別々に確認しています。 解析解同じ問題の参照 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える u_\theta=2\log\frac{\cosh(\theta/2)}{\cosh(\theta(x-1/2))},\quad\lambda(\theta)=2\theta^2/\cosh^2(\theta/2) 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。 実行例の参照と結果 補助実行例 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの67固定判定が合格。離散残差、接線の向き・単位長、fold方程式・null条件・transversality、独立Decimal80解析族、固定3格子の誤差を別々に確認しています。 保存結果 / JSON 参照・検証条件の詳細 → 計算法 hΣdu²+dλ²の重み付き単位接線、予測点と接線超平面によるNewton補正。別の拡大系でfoldと正規化null vectorを解きます。このcaseは疎Jacobianを明示的に組み立てます。 この問題の実行例で使う手法 重み付き擬似弧長継続 手法台帳の状態：教育用例・関連コードあり Armijo減衰Newton法 手法台帳の状態：教育用例・関連コードあり 空間中心差分 text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Preview of the stored branch,lambda=2 profiles,smallest Jacobian singular value and three-grid fold error. Arclength steps are not physical time. Equations and problem definitions Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time. Bratu nonlinear boundary-value problem −d2udx2=λeu,0<x<1 u(0)=u(1)=0 The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. Formulations used by execution examples Supplementary execution exampleExample definition or validation formula Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation −u′′=λeu,u(0)=u(1)=0 uθ=2log⁡cosh⁡(θ/2)cosh⁡(θ(x−1/2)),λ(θ)=2θ2/cosh⁡2(θ/2) Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family. Exact and reference solutions The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately. Analytic referenceReference for the same problem Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation u_\theta=2\log\frac{\cosh(\theta/2)}{\cosh(\theta(x-1/2))},\quad\lambda(\theta)=2\theta^2/\cosh^2(\theta/2) Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim. References and results of execution examples Supplementary execution example Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately. Saved result / JSON Reference and validation details → Numerical methods Use a unit tangent in h-sum(du squared)+d-lambda squared, a predictor and a tangent-hyperplane Newton corrector. A separate augmented system locates the fold and a normalized null vector. This case deliberately assembles sparse Jacobians. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Validation limits A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.
